sources.title: Kimi K2 Instruct catalog source and checkpoint link
sources.evidence: The source record explicitly links moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct. This resolves the catalog identity to the original downloadable Instruct checkpoint; catalog specifications are not used as primary technical evidence.

sources.title: Original Kimi-K2-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the original post-trained Instruct model, without long thinking, with nominal 1T total/32B active, MoE/MLA, 128K context, text chat and native tool calling. It links its paper and public weights, and marks Instruct-0905 as a newer version.

sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence, July 2025 report
sources.evidence: Abstract footnote 1 directly links the original Instruct checkpoint. Section 2.3 and Table 2 report a MoE Transformer with MLA, 1.04T total and 32.6B activated parameters. Table 4 separately labels 1043B for Kimi-K2-Base, not Instruct.

sources.title: Kimi K2 report, February 2026 revision
sources.evidence: The later revision retains the direct original Instruct checkpoint link and the Table 2 figures of 1.04T total and 32.6B activated parameters. Its Table 4 still labels the separate Base model at 1043B.

sources.title: Original Instruct checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Defines kimi_k2 and DeepseekV3ForCausalLM, 61 layers, one initial dense layer, 384 routed experts, eight selected experts, one shared expert, 64 attention heads and max_position_embeddings 131072. The distributed checkpoint uses block FP8; no storage counts are used.

sources.title: Original Instruct checkpoint model implementation
sources.evidence: DeepseekV3Model is a Transformer decoder; its layers combine attention with DeepseekV3MoE after the configured initial dense layer. DeepseekV3ForCausalLM maps token embeddings to vocabulary logits.

sources.title: Original Instruct Modified MIT license text
sources.evidence: Copyright 2025 Moonshot AI. MIT permissions and notice requirements are modified to require prominent Kimi K2 UI branding when a commercial product/service exceeds 100 million monthly active users or US$20 million monthly revenue.

sources.title: Original Instruct public repository metadata and file listing
sources.evidence: Exact repository id and author match the checkpoint; private=false and gated=false. Lists model safetensors files and text-generation pipeline. Repository creation is July 11, 2025, corroborating but not independently defining public release.

sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence release announcement
sources.evidence: Announces release of Base and Instruct; explicitly describes Instruct as without long thinking and original K2 as lacking vision. A separate 0905 update links newer weights and 256K context.

sources.title: Moonshot AI blog publication index
sources.evidence: Dates the Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence announcement July 11, 2025; separately dates the 0905 update September 5 and Thinking release November 6.

sources.title: Kimi Open Platform feature release log
sources.evidence: Explicitly records the original Kimi K2 API launch as kimi-k2-0711-preview on July 11, 2025; separately records the 0905 and Thinking launches. Used as chronology corroboration, not proof that hosted weights are byte-identical.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 comparison card
sources.evidence: Identifies an updated Instruct release, raises context from 128K to 256K, and compares K2-Instruct-0905 against K2-Instruct-0711. Its size table describes 0905, not a newly disclosed original-Instruct count.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Thinking model card
sources.evidence: Describes a distinct thinking model with interleaved chain-of-thought/tool calls, native INT4 and 256K context; these properties are not transferred to the original Instruct checkpoint.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.5 model card
sources.evidence: Describes a later multimodal model with instant/thinking modes and a vision encoder. Its comparison tables do not provide a replacement exact original-Instruct parameter count; these later capabilities are not transferred.

name.note: The catalog source links this exact original Instruct repository; the paper uses Kimi-K2-Instruct. The display name is equivalent.

developer.note: Official Moonshot AI repository, attribution and license copyright agree.

family.note: Normalized Kimi K2 family name; the exact checkpoint config identifies model_type kimi_k2.

release_date.note: Official blog index dates the announcement releasing Instruct on July 11; API launch log and exact repository creation corroborate. September 0905 and November Thinking are separate releases.

open_weights.note: Exact model files are publicly listed in an ungated repository, and the card expressly releases the weights. No shards were downloaded.

license.note: Actual license permits use, modification and redistribution with notice; its additional UI-branding condition applies above either stated commercial threshold. This is not unmodified MIT.

parameters_b.note: Table 2 reports 1.04T total, converted to 1040 billion at published rounded precision, not an exact tensor count. The paper directly links this original Instruct checkpoint; the card uses nominal 1T. Table 4 reports 1043B only for Base, so that finer value is not assigned to Instruct.

active_parameters_b.note: Separately reported activated-parameter row in Table 2 gives 32.6B; retained in v2. This is the published rounded active count, not derived by dividing the total or counting storage. The card uses nominal 32B.

architecture.note: MoE decoder-only Transformer with MLA. Exact checkpoint config matches the report architecture: 61 layers, one dense layer, 384 routed experts with eight selected and one shared expert.

context_window.note: Exact original checkpoint config sets 131072 positions, resolving the card's 128K. The separate 0905 update's 256K is excluded.

modalities.note: Original checkpoint is text generation through token embeddings and a vocabulary head; original announcement explicitly excludes vision. K2.5 multimodality is a later model.

reasoning.note: False denotes no dedicated long-thinking mode: the exact Instruct card and release explicitly classify it as without long thinking. This does not imply inability to solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Exact Instruct card documents native tool calls with schemas and parsing guidance, and the paper evaluates original Instruct tool use.

description.value: Non-thinking Kimi K2 MoE instruction model for coding and tool-using agents
description.note: Supported description of the original post-trained model; no later Thinking or multimodal capabilities are implied.

patch.notes: Original July 11, 2025 Instruct checkpoint, distinct from Instruct-0905, K2 Thinking and K2.5. July technical-report Table 2, unchanged in the February 2026 revision, reports 1.04T total and 32.6B active: rounded published figures, versus nominal 1T/32B in the card, not exact tensor counts. Table 4's 1043B is explicitly for Base and is not transferred. Original context is 131072; reasoning=false means no dedicated long-thinking mode. Modified MIT includes a Kimi K2 UI-branding condition above 100M monthly active users or US$20M monthly revenue.

sources.label: July Kimi K2 technical report, Table 2

summary: Resolved the exact original July Instruct checkpoint through the catalog link and report footnote. Added separately published rounded totals of 1040B and 32.6B active plus MoE architecture. Confirmed all 14 fields, including original 128K context, explicit non-thinking classification, tool calling, public weights, actual Modified MIT terms and July 11 release. Kept 0905, Thinking and K2.5 separate; no unsupported nullable baseline assertions remain.
